//: Typecheck only. `astro build` does not read this file, so Astro and Vite keep
resolving the real `three` runtime out of node_modules exactly as before — the
paths below point the COMPILER at declarations and nothing else, and aliasing
the bundle to .d.ts files is the failure mode this arrangement exists to avoid.
The declarations live in .typedeps/, a real isolated install: node_modules here
is a junction into a second checkout, and writing @types into it would put bytes
in another repository that neither project records. Restore it with:
`ci`, not `install`: it installs what .typedeps/package-lock.json resolved and
fails loudly if the manifest and the lockfile disagree. The `install @pkg@ver`
form this line used to carry did the opposite — it rewrote the manifest and
ignored the lockfile, which is how the manifest came to say ^0.180.0 while
this comment claimed an exact pin. Manifest, lockfile and this instruction
now all say 0.180.0, which is the runtime's exact version (three 0.180.0).
No ambient stubs, no `any` module declarations, no relaxed strictness: those
silence the diagnostic without restoring a single type.
